posts.post:
tucking in your shirt or leaving it untucked.

you can only choose one for the rest of your life.

why is the standard sizing across brands so wildly different?

it’s not a guessing game, it’s just poor manufacturing.

sitting in a waiting room and realizing you’re the only person not wearing a giant logo on your chest.

it’s a strange kind of quiet.

we spent three hours debating if a pocket is actually useful or just dead weight.

we deleted the pocket.
